name: JMSFusion
description: Frontend enhancement plugin for Jellyfin Web and web-wrapper mobile clients (Zigerus fork of ParticularFlix JMSFusion, Jellyfin 12). Native Android TV clients are not supported.
overview: Custom script loader for the Jellyfin web UI.

versions.changelog:
### New in the details popup
- **Choose the audio track and subtitles before you press Play.** When a film or episode has more than one audio track, an Audio dropdown sits under the buttons; when it has subtitles, a Subtitles dropdown (with Off) sits next to it. Each opens on the track Jellyfin would pick for you (your language settings, or the tracks you chose last time for this title), and Play Now plays what you chose. Items with one audio track and no subtitles look as before.
- **Add to playlist**, next to Go to Page: lists your Jellyfin playlists (audio-only playlists are left out) and can create a new playlist with the title in it.

### Fixes
- **Hero backdrops appear as soon as the slider rotates on its own.** With slide animations on, a slide change hides the incoming backdrop and waits for its image to load before fading it in. The next slides' images are preloaded in the background, so they had already loaded and nothing faded them in: the backdrop stayed invisible until the mouse moved over the hero or the slider moved on. A backdrop that is already loaded now fades in straight away.

### Fixes
- **The player header shows the title you are watching, not the previous one.** When a video streams without its item id in the URL (an HLS stream while transcoding), the header's logo, star rating, tomato score and age rating came from the first favourite button in the page. Jellyfin keeps earlier pages hidden in the page, so that could be the previous title's player or item page; it showed most often after starting something from the MonWUI popup on the home page. The header now only reads a page that is showing, the player page first. When it falls back to the server's session list, it prefers this browser's own session over another device's.

### Faster on TVs
- **TV web browsers no longer load any part of MonWUI.** With "Disable MonWUI for TV web clients" on, TVs used to get the full MonWUI page header (an import map, about 96 module preloads and the boot scripts) and then download each file empty. That was about 100 extra requests on every page load. TVs now get Jellyfin's page with the MonWUI block removed, plus the small remote-focus helper written inline. On a TV-speed test the home page shows its first card in half the time (2.5 s to 1.2 s) with half the requests. Desktop and phone browsers are unchanged.

### Fixes
- **The hero slider and custom rows no longer disappear when you click the server logo.** The logo links to `#/`, which Jellyfin immediately turns back into `#/home` while building a brand-new home page. MonWUI saw the same address as before and did nothing, so the slider and its rows stayed with the discarded page, and "My Media" moved up under the header. MonWUI now notices when the home page itself is replaced, and rebuilds the slider and rows in your saved order.
- **The settings button on "Who's watching" opens its menu right there.** It used to close the chooser and open Jellyfin's user menu at the top-left of the home page. The same entries (Profile, Settings, Dashboard and Metadata Manager for admins, Quick Connect, Sign out) now open under the gear, inside the chooser. Escape, clicking elsewhere, or the gear again closes just the menu.
- **The Runtime Status on the plugin page no longer looks like an error.** An empty Script Directory is the normal setup: the plugin uses its built-in scripts, which update with it. The card now shows "Script source: Built into the plugin" and "Custom script directory: Not used", instead of "Configured: No", "Directory exists: No" and a yellow "Using embedded assets: Yes". The Script Directory hint now says to leave it empty.

### Fixes
- **The update check now watches this fork.** MonWUI's built-in update notice, its "update available" links and the GitHub link on the settings page pointed at the ParticularFlix repository, so the plugin could suggest their releases, which do not include this fork's changes. They now point at github.com/Zigerus/Jellyfin-MonWUI-Plugin. The link to the original G-grbz project is kept.

Fixes the three known issues listed for 4.0.0.71. Settings are kept.

### Fixes
- **No more page reload after logging in.** Jellyfin's login screen does not reload the page, but MonWUI saw the new user as a profile switch the first time it saved a setting and reloaded the freshly loaded home page. It now loads the signed-in user's own settings the moment the login completes, before the home page appears. Switching profiles and signing out still reload, as before.
- **No more 401 errors on the login page.** The parental PIN status and studio hub visibility checks ran before anyone was signed in. They now wait for a signed-in user.
- **No more "getScrollSlider is not a function" with a custom home section order.** Jellyfin adds a row of scroll arrows each time a row is attached to the page and never removes the old one. When MonWUI moved a row into your chosen order, the row ended up with a second set of arrows wired to the wrong element. MonWUI now waits until a row's arrows are ready, removes them before moving the row, and lets Jellyfin build exactly one set again.

First release of the Zigerus fork (github.com/Zigerus/Jellyfin-MonWUI-Plugin). Same code as ParticularFlix 4.0.0.7, plus the changes below. Same plugin GUID, so it upgrades any JMSFusion install in place, and your settings are kept.

### New
- **Turn MonWUI off for TV web browsers** (Plugins, then JMSFusion, then "Disable MonWUI for TV web clients"). TV browsers whose User-Agent matches the pattern get the stock Jellyfin web UI: the slider and modules are served empty, and a small focus helper keeps the remote working. The default pattern `Web0S|SmartTV|WebAppManager|Tizen` covers LG webOS and Samsung Tizen. The setting is **off by default**. Desktop, phone and native apps are not affected.

### Build
- Built against the Jellyfin 12.0.0 packages, so the `12.0.0.0` minimum this release declares is the real minimum (4.0.0.7 compiled against 12.3.0).
- Releases are now built by GitHub Actions and published to this fork's own plugin repository: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zigerus/Jellyfin-MonWUI-Plugin/main/manifest.json`.

### Known issues (found on Jellyfin 12.4.0, to be fixed next)
- The page reloads once right after you log in.
- The login page shows two harmless 401 errors in the browser console.
- With a custom home section order, the console can show `getScrollSlider is not a function`.
